scheme.title: Resource Type
scheme.description: Kind of resource a record describes.

concepts.label: Dataset
concepts.description: Data in any form: raster, vector, tabular or a mix.

concepts.label: Service
concepts.description: An endpoint that serves data: WMS/WFS, OGC API, STAC API, Earth Engine, REST.

concepts.label: Document
concepts.description: A report, plan, manual or article that is the resource itself.

concepts.label: Model
concepts.description: A trained or calibrated model and its parameters.
